fine_lines.title: You must vs Perhaps you should think about
fine_lines.explanation_ar: You must أمر مباشر وقوي، أما Perhaps you should think about + فعل ing فهي طريقة مهذبة وناعمة لطلب التغيير، وهي أفضل عند إعطاء التقييم.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "You must" is a strong, direct order. "Perhaps you should think about + verb-ing" is a soft, polite way to ask for change, better for feedback.

examples.sentence: Perhaps you should think about arriving a little earlier.

fine_lines.title: I'm unhappy vs I'm a little bit concerned
fine_lines.explanation_ar: عبارة I'm a little bit concerned about تخفّف النقد وتجعله مهذبًا، بينما I'm unhappy مباشرة أكثر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I'm a little bit concerned about" makes criticism softer and more polite than "I'm unhappy".

examples.sentence: I'm a little bit concerned about your report.

grammar.title: Soft (polite) feedback patterns
grammar.explanation_ar: لتقديم ملاحظة سلبية بلطف: (1) I'm a little bit concerned about + اسم أو فعل ing. (2) You need to work on + اسم. (3) Perhaps you should think about + فعل ing. كلمات مثل a little bit و perhaps تخفّف الكلام.
grammar.explanation_en: To give negative feedback politely: (1) I'm a little bit concerned about + noun/verb-ing. (2) You need to work on + noun. (3) Perhaps you should think about + verb-ing. Words like "a little bit" and "perhaps" make it softer.
examples: I'm a little bit concerned about your emails.
You need to work on your presentation skills.
Perhaps you should think about being more polite to clients.
